displayName: Map potential acquirers for a company
summary: Build a prioritised buyer map for an M&A process.

useCases.title: Map potential acquirers for a company
useCases.message: Help me build a buyer map for an M&A process. Ask me about the company being sold. You might want to research what makes a strong acquirer in that space before asking me to define it. Then map strategic and financial buyers, evaluate their track record, and give me a prioritised list with rationale.
